title: What do seeds need?
_map: What do seeds need? (Y2). Big idea: plants need water, light and the right temperature. Creative: run a test on the farm: one seed with no water, one in the dark; predict which grows. Then do it for real.
_story: Steve plants three seeds: one with water and light, one with no water, one in a dark cupboard. Ismaeel predicts, then watches time speed up. A fair test.
_stepChain: seeds grow into plants → what do they need? → a fair test: change only one thing → predict → watch them grow → water and light both matter → do it for real

talk.ask: Which seed grew best, and why?
talk.goodAnswer: the one with water and light; the dry one hardly grew, and the dark one grew pale and weak.

talk.ask: Why did we only change one thing for each pot?
talk.goodAnswer: so we know which thing made the difference. That's a fair test.

handsOn: Plant 3 cress seeds or beans in cups: one watered on a windowsill, one not watered, one watered in a dark cupboard. Check every day for a week!

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: I planted three seeds. One gets water and light. One gets no water. One gets water, but lives in a dark cupboard.
Each pot is the same, except for one thing. Changing only one thing at a time is called a fair test. That way we know what made the difference.

question.prompt: Which seed do you think will grow best?
question.reveal: Let's speed up time and watch. Water and light: tall and green! No water: hardly anything. In the dark: it grew, but it's pale and floppy, stretching to find light.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: The dark one grew a bit! So plants don't really need light.

question.prompt: Does the dark seed show plants don't need light?
question.onRight: Yes, you looked closely. It's pale and weak. It used up the food in the seed, but it can't make more without light.

0.mistake: only looked at whether it grew, not how well
0.hint: Compare the dark one with the one in the light. Is it as strong and green?
0.say: It grew a little using the food stored in the seed. But it's pale and floppy. Without light, its leaves can't make more food, so it won't last.

question.reveal: Plants need light to stay strong and green.

rule.text: Seeds need water, light and warmth to grow well.
rule.ask: Can you say what a seed needs, and what a fair test is? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: Seeds need water, light and warmth to grow well. A fair test changes only one thing at a time.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: what if we put a watered seed in the freezer?
bonus.reveal: It won't grow. Seeds need the right temperature too: not too cold.
